# The tests that the fuzz-asan job (.github/workflows/windows.yml) does not run under AddressSanitizer, besides the
# tests of smoke-exclude.txt: <name> <reason>, one per line.
#
# Every other test that "vpntest list" prints runs there: a new test is a new file with a RANZ_TEST line
# (src/vpntest/testlist.h) and needs no line here. A line names a test that vpntest lists, or the script fails.
harness      has time budgets that AddressSanitizer would exceed; build_and_test runs it
bench        has time budgets that AddressSanitizer would exceed; build_and_test runs it
certdl       measures the client timeouts, time windows that AddressSanitizer would distort; build_and_test runs it
nodesvc      installs ranz-node as a service, which would run outside the instrumented process; build_and_test runs it
quic         needs msquic.dll, which this job does not fetch (noisehub runs its loopback part here)
quicbind     needs msquic.dll, which this job does not fetch, and measures throughput and CPU, which AddressSanitizer distorts
sourcelimits needs msquic.dll, which this job does not fetch, and floods sockets and UDP, which AddressSanitizer slows; build_and_test runs it
switchbench  measures how forwarding scales across cores, which AddressSanitizer distorts; build_and_test runs it
